purpose: Plane 6 eight failure classes with machine criteria, boundary tests, disposition policy and Q39 mapping.

failure_classes.definition: Failure at source side: missing/corrupt/unreadable source, provenance fail-closed, rights-restricted, malformed temporal kept UNKNOWN.
failure_classes.machine_criteria: failure point at Plane 1 ingestion boundary; no Object record yet produced.
boundary_tests: A1: replace with perfect synthetic source; failure disappears -> INPUT_SOURCE.
A2: failure limited to this source/observation lineage -> INPUT_SOURCE.

failure_classes.definition: Failure in interpretation/extraction: source intact but source->observation->object diverges from source content.
failure_classes.machine_criteria: source integrity passes; >=1 Object/Assertion content disagrees with source digest.
boundary_tests: B1: remove mechanism execution; failure persists -> EXTRACTION_MODEL/REPRESENTATION.

failure_classes.definition: Failure in representational capacity: extraction correct but target schema/envelope cannot carry losslessly.
failure_classes.machine_criteria: extraction verified correct; failure locates to schema field gap or semantic loss.
boundary_tests: B3: object content correct but envelope cannot carry -> REPRESENTATION.

failure_classes.machine_criteria: input object correct; failure is one of Plane 4 contract checks; infrastructure healthy.
boundary_tests: B2: input object correct and failure is contract check -> MECHANISM.

failure_classes.definition: Failure in carrying layer: store crash, pointer/manifest corruption, validator fault, env-induced replay divergence, CI/toolchain.
failure_classes.machine_criteria: failure at carrying layer; same input succeeds on healthy infra; no contract defect.
boundary_tests: same input on healthy infra succeeds -> INFRASTRUCTURE_RUNTIME.

failure_classes.definition: Failure in architecture contract itself: missing/contradictory plane boundary, undecidable routing, conflicting invariants.
failure_classes.machine_criteria: counterfactual: perfect source + each component compliant, failure still reproduces; spans all objects through that contract path.
boundary_tests: A1: perfect source still fails -> ARCHITECTURE.

failure_classes.definition: Governance/value-boundary refusal: system refuses per governance contract (rights, charter, ceiling, auto-PROMOTE/EVOLVE ban, external action ban).
failure_classes.machine_criteria: a governance registry/charter entry is hit; system behavior matches governance contract.
boundary_tests: governance entry hit and behavior correct -> GOVERNANCE_REFUSAL.

failure_classes.machine_criteria: any required criterion field missing/contradictory -> forced UNKNOWN (fail-closed).
boundary_tests: evidence insufficient -> UNKNOWN; never 'closest class' guess.
